description.name: Entry
description.text: FIfteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Sublime Thunder], [Damage Cap +10000], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Lightning, Holy)] and [Watchful Protector Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Sublime Thunder
description.text: Lightning and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Ascending Presence after using Lightning and Holy abilities

description.name: Ascending Presence
description.text: Six single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] and [Buff Holy 10% (15s)] to the user every second use

description.name: Buff Lightning 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Lightning damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Lightning, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Holy ability

description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Watchful Protector Mode
description.text: Cast speed x2.00, keeps track of the number of uses of Lightning or Holy abilities used (0~4), grants [Watchful Protector Critical Chance] after using a Lightning or Holy ability

description.name: Watchful Protector Critical Chance
description.text: Critical chance =0/25/50/75/100% scaling with [Watchful Protector Mode], removed if the character hasn't [Watchful Protector Mode]
